Inspect or close an engine

Source: R/engine.R
laya_engine_info.Rd

laya_engine_info() reports what an engine loaded: checkpoint, ONNX layout, file paths, sequence budgets (max_len, head_max_len) and calibration temperatures. laya_engine_close() frees the model's memory right away instead of waiting for garbage collection; the engine can't be used afterwards.

Usage

laya_engine_info(engine)

laya_engine_close(engine)

Arguments

engine

A laya_engine.

Value

laya_engine_info() returns a list; laya_engine_close() returns engine, invisibly.

Examples

if (laya_model_available()) {
  engine <- laya_engine()
  str(laya_engine_info(engine), max.level = 1)
  laya_engine_close(engine)
}
